messages:
sarah-support: MicroFin (sasha) reports the PO number disappeared from invoice INV-98765 after our VAT recalculation job ran last night. They need a reissued invoice that includes PO 42-PO-112233 for their AP team. Ticket SUP-4552.
aj-billing: thanks. can you paste the invoice payload we sent to them? I want to confirm whether the purchase_order field was stripped or just not rendered in the PDF.
sarah-support: pasted below (pulled from audit logs). note purchase_order was present before the recalculation at 2026-02-14T02:10:12Z.
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-98765",
  "customer": "MicroFin",
  "amount": 12500.00,
  "taxes": 2500.00,
  "purchase_order": null,
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "Dedicated GPUs (reserved)", "qty": 5, "unit": 2500.00}
  ],
  "last_recalc": "2026-02-14T02:13:07Z",
  "recalc_reason": "vat_recalc_v3.2"
}
```
leo-eng: :eyes: looks like the recompute job is setting purchase_order to null when rounding_delta != 0. reproducer: run vat_recalc_v3.2 with invoice having rounding discrepancy.
leo-eng: repro steps I used:
1) checkout tax-service@v3.2
2) run `./scripts/recalc_invoice --id INV-98765 --simulate`
3) note `purchase_order` flips to null in output JSON.
maria-finance: we need a clean customer-facing path: generate a credit note for INV-98765 and reissue INV-98765-R1 that keeps PO 42-PO-112233. finance prefers manual credit + reissue for audit trail. tagging invoice as `reissued_for_po`.
aj-billing: agreed. proposed steps for support to execute (low-risk):
- create credit note CN-98765 via billing CLI
- create new invoice INV-98765-R1 with same line items + purchase_order set to 42-PO-112233
- link CN-98765 to the new invoice
- send reissued PDF to customer and cc finance

aj-billing: billing CLI snippets:
```bash
# create credit note
billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-98765 --reason "reissue for PO" --actor sarah-support

# create reissued invoice (manual fields)
billing-cli invoice create --customer MicroFin --lines "5x GPU reserved:2500" --tax 2500 --po "42-PO-112233" --ref INV-98765-R1 --tag reissued_for_po

# link credit note
billing-cli credit apply --credit CN-98765 --invoice INV-98765-R1
```
sarah-support: executing now. I'll attach the generated CN and new invoice when done. pinging @maria-finance for approval once the PDFs are ready.
deploy-bot: tax-service v3.2 deploy rolled back to v3.1 at 2026-02-14T02:45:21Z by leo-eng (rollback reason: purchase_order field regression).
maria-finance: approved. once support uploads INV-98765-R1 to the portal, I'll mark the old invoice as superseded and note the GL entries.
sasha-microfin: thanks team — we received the reissued invoice INV-98765-R1 and it includes PO 42-PO-112233. AP is happy to process. Please send final confirmation when CN-98765 is applied. :white_check_mark:
sarah-support: CN-98765 applied to INV-98765-R1, PDFs uploaded to the portal, and email sent to sasha@microfin. closing SUP-4552. tagging follow-up ticket ENG-7620 for fixing the tax recompute bug so it doesn't clear purchase_order in future.
leo-eng: noted ENG-7620 created, assigned to tax-service team, ETA next patch window. thanks all.
